## ADDED Requirements

### Requirement: Tests using real git repositories show a verdict whose head SHA differs from...

The system SHALL ensure that tests using real git repositories show a verdict whose head SHA differs from the live head but whose patch-id matches is accepted, and one whose patch-id differs is rejected with a 'stale verdict' block reason.

#### Scenario: Tests using real git repositories show a verdict whose head SHA differs from...

WHEN `bind-merge-verdicts-to-head-sha-and-patch-id` is implemented
THEN Tests using real git repositories show a verdict whose head SHA differs from the live head but whose patch-id matches is accepted, and one whose patch-id differs is rejected with a 'stale verdict' block reason.

### Requirement: execution_safety never returns 'no block' for a missing or non-eligible...

The system SHALL ensure that execution_safety never returns 'no block' for a missing or non-eligible verdict unless a waiver reason is present in merge-plan.json, and a recorded operator override path exists that is never silent.

#### Scenario: execution_safety never returns 'no block' for a missing or non-eligible...

WHEN `bind-merge-verdicts-to-head-sha-and-patch-id` is implemented
THEN execution_safety never returns 'no block' for a missing or non-eligible verdict unless a waiver reason is present in merge-plan.json, and a recorded operator override path exists that is never silent.

### Requirement: A verdict whose reviewer identity (vendor + session/agent id) equals the PR...

The system SHALL ensure that a verdict whose reviewer identity (vendor + session/agent id) equals the PR author identity is rejected.

#### Scenario: A verdict whose reviewer identity (vendor + session/agent id) equals the PR...

WHEN `bind-merge-verdicts-to-head-sha-and-patch-id` is implemented
THEN A verdict whose reviewer identity (vendor + session/agent id) equals the PR author identity is rejected.

### Requirement: No code path reads `iterate_consensus_path` while nothing writes it, and the...

The system SHALL ensure that no code path reads `iterate_consensus_path` while nothing writes it, and the change extends the add-orchestrator-adjudication-review-gate structures in execution_safety.py/convergence_loop.py (declared overlap) instead of adding a parallel gate.

#### Scenario: No code path reads `iterate_consensus_path` while nothing writes it, and the...

WHEN `bind-merge-verdicts-to-head-sha-and-patch-id` is implemented
THEN No code path reads `iterate_consensus_path` while nothing writes it, and the change extends the add-orchestrator-adjudication-review-gate structures in execution_safety.py/convergence_loop.py (declared overlap) instead of adding a parallel gate.

### Requirement: merge-pull-requests SKILL.md stays line-neutral, with new guidance in...

The system SHALL ensure that merge-pull-requests SKILL.md stays line-neutral, with new guidance in references/ files.

#### Scenario: merge-pull-requests SKILL.md stays line-neutral, with new guidance in...

WHEN `bind-merge-verdicts-to-head-sha-and-patch-id` is implemented
THEN merge-pull-requests SKILL.md stays line-neutral, with new guidance in references/ files.
